description: Broadcast a signed raw transaction to a specified blockchain network via eth_sendRawTransaction. Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration for full access, or uses the keyless public endpoint if permitted on the chain (keys must not be passed in tool parameters or chat). Returns the transaction hash or JSON-RPC error.

chain.description: Target blockchain network slug (e.g. 'robinhood_mainnet'). Must exist in GET /v1/chains.

raw_tx.description: Signed raw transaction data as a 0x-prefixed hex string (the RLP-encoded raw transaction).

name: send_raw_transaction

balance_units.description: Remaining balance units after this request (only present when balance is known and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

cu_charged.description: Compute Units billed for this request (only present when charged and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

signup_url.description: Registration and sign-up URL (returned when rate-limited on the public endpoint).

title: Send Raw Transaction
